name: doxylamine
uses: Use helps to reduce difficulty in falling asleep
otcwarn: Do not use in children under 12 years of age Ask a doctor before use if you have a breathing problem such as asthma, emphysema or chronic bronchitis glaucoma trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking any other drugs Stop use and ask a doctor if sleeplessness persists continuously for more than two weeks. Insomnia may be a symptom of serious underlying medical illness.
